narr: Thunderstorms lead to locally heavy rainfall and flooding in Celebration.
ev: Multiple automated rain gauges reported rainfall totals between 3.8 to 5.25 inches. Osceola County Dispatch reported at least one car stranded in high water on Celebration Blvd.
lsr: Osceola Co Dispatch reports at least one car stranded in high water on Celebration Blvd.
